verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships two first-party AI features that work on the user's own repository data inside the app. One generates AI commit-message suggestions from staged diffs, which are sent to OpenAI on an opt-in basis. The other is a conversational Repository Agent that can browse, search and read repository content (docs-29, docs-64). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of analytical insights such as summaries or code review beyond commit messages, in-depth docs on what the agent can explain or recommend, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either AI feature.
